newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa aims to have national lottery by end 1997.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa aims to have national lottery by end 1997.

text.p: The South African government said on Wednesday it expected to have a national lottery in place before the end of 1997.
The Department of Trade and Industry, which was recently given responsibility for the lottery, said in a statement it would appoint experts to help appoint an appropriate operator.
"It is envisaged that an operator for the national lottery will be appointed before the end of 1997," the department said.
Draft legislation on a lottery has already been tabled in parliament.
The department said it envisaged that South Africa would have one of the most advanced national lotteries, the proceeds of which would be used to deliver on government programmes.

A number of foreign parties, including UK football pools operator Littlewoods, Malaysia's Mycom Berhad and Tony O'Reilly's Independent Newspaper Holdings Ltd, have already expressed an interest in bidding for the lottery licence.
